title: horizon-native.json
description: The manifest of an .hnmod (Horizon native mod). Unknown keys are refused. Reference: docs/native-mods.md in Horizon.

horizon.description: The exact Horizon commit it was tested on.

mixins.description: The exact horizon-mixins commit it was tested with.

hooks.description: The hook points' version (NATIVE_HOOKS_API) it needs: it then builds on any Horizon with that version or later.
